full_judgment: 2. The necessary facts for disposal of this Rule are that the opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 13 of 1996 for declaration of Title and recovery of khas possession of the suit land after removing the shop of the defendants. During pendency of the suit for peremptory hearing the defendant-petitioners filed an application under Order XXVI, Rule 9 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for local investigation.
